page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: a short block of text near the centre with the closing words "Tantum." and "LAUS DEO." and a printer's ornament below them. Right page: the right-hand column of an alphabetical index, cut off by the edge of the scan.
page.notes: Left page: the upside-down, mirrored lines at the top and the faint lines in the middle are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are left out. A faint "38" and a faint word in the left margin look like show-through too, so they are left out. No running head, page number or signature is clearly printed. The ornament below "LAUS DEO." is a printer's ornament, not text. Right page: the index column is cut off by the scan edge, so the entries are copied only as far as they are visible; anything beyond the edge is not shown. The entries after "Acha" are partly obscured and uncertain, and the italic "sy" beside "Acha" is doubtful.
